The '''LPL 2015 Summer''' split was the second split of the [[LoL Pro League]] (''LPL'') season, organized by Tencent Games and Riot Games from 22 May to 23 August 2015 at the Shanghai E-Sports Arena. Twelve teams competed in a Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo2}} Group Stage followed by a Gauntlet and Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} Playoffs. Two teams entered through the [[LPL/2015/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion]]—[[Masters 3]] and [[Unlimited Potential]]—the latter formed when [[Vici Potential Gaming]] acquired [[Gamtee]]'s slot. From the LSPL pathway, [[Qiao Gu Reapers]] and [[Royal Never Give Up]] qualified by winning their brackets, with RNG formed after [[Royal Club]] acquired [[Vici Potential Gaming]]'s slot. Championship Points determined the first Chinese seed for the [[World_Championship/2015|2015 World Championship]], with the next four teams advancing to the [[LPL/2015/Regional_Finals|Regional Finals]].

===Playoffs===
{{#lst:LPL/2015/Summer/Playoffs|Playoffs}}

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo2}}
*** A 2-0 victory gives the winning team 3 points
*** A 1-1 tie gives both teams 1 point
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''3rd till 5th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''6th place''}} advance to the Gauntlet second round.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''7th and 8th place''}} advance to the Gauntlet first round.
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th till 12th place''}} will have to play in the [[LPL/2015/Summer/Promotion|Promotion Tournament]].
* '''Playoffs'''
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Stage 1 is a 4-team King of the Hill bracket
*** 7th and 8th place face off in the first round
*** Winner faces 6th place team
*** Winner qualifies for quarterfinals and faces 5th place team in a reseeding match
** Stage 2 is single elimination
*** 3rd and 4th place face Gauntlet finalists based on who won the reseeding match
*** Winners move on to Semifinals to face 1st and 2nd place
*** Losers move to the 3rd place match, winners play in the finals
*** The team with the most Championship points qualifies for the [[World_Championship/2015|World Championship]] as China's 1st seed
*** Next 4 teams in the points ranking qualify for the [[LPL/2015/Regional_Finals|Regional Finals]]
